actual: The formal N2-B v2 two-survivor audit request advpkgareq_d97d22508f04d27f1b37b82c fails at package_batch_prediction after 15603.392 seconds because peak RSS reaches 17413373952 bytes above the frozen 17179869184-byte limit. The same run writes an undeclared model/__pycache__/model.cpython-310.pyc into the PKG_378EB9 frozen workspace, so a subsequent read fails the roster-drift guard. The complete 386-day, 57-factor, two-package PIT/parity workload must finish within the existing RSS/temp fail-closed contract without raising limits, disabling resource checks, trimming factors/dates/universe, substituting retired packages, mutating frozen workspaces, or changing prediction values, dtype, index, or hashes.

events.note: The failed formal run held about 9.1-9.4 GB resident but reached a transient 17,413,373,952-byte peak in the full future-poison factor window. Direct code review found redundant post-fancy-index daily/static copies plus an extra static copy before precompute. Readback also found one undeclared model/__pycache__/model.cpython-310.pyc created at model load. The fix removes only redundant adapter copies, disables bytecode during frozen model load, and revalidates the workspace roster after each load; factor code, window, PIT, parity, model outputs and resource limits remain frozen.

expected: The unchanged two-survivor, 386-day, 57-factor N2-B v2 workload must preserve exact PIT, future-poison, file-backed parity, prediction value/dtype/index/hash, frozen workspace roster, RSS and temporary-space fail-closed semantics while avoiding redundant full-panel copies that push peak RSS above 17179869184 bytes or interpreter bytecode writes into package assets.
